## Where

- [ ] rule  - [ ] guideline  - [ ] skill  - [ ] hook  - [ ] script  - [ ] template  - [ ] docs

## Checks

- [ ] Follows CONTRIBUTING.md ("What goes where", established terms, no duplicate skill).
- [ ] ABAP examples state the release they compile on.
- [ ] No customer, employer, system or personal data.
- [ ] Hook or script changed: tests added or updated, and they pass (CI runs them).
- [ ] Third-party material: licence allows redistribution, `SOURCES.json` / `SOURCES.md` / `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` updated.
